paper.title: Observation of quantum entanglement with top quarks at the ATLAS detector

result.summary: 该论文报告了在大型强子对撞机（LHC）上利用 ATLAS 探测器，在质心能量 13 TeV、积分亮度 140 fb⁻¹ 的质子-质子对撞数据中，于顶夸克-反顶夸克（t\bar{t}）对产生过程中观测到了量子纠缠 [abstract]。研究通过测量由母顶夸克静止系中带电轻子间夹角推断出的单可观测量 D 来探测自旋纠缠，并在接近 t\bar{t} 产生阈值的窄区间内进行测量 [abstract]。在 340 < m_{t\bar{t}} < 380 GeV 区间，测得 D = −0.537 ± 0.002 (stat.) ± 0.019 (syst.)，与无纠缠假设的偏差超过五个标准差 [abstract]。这是首次在夸克对中观测到纠缠，也是迄今最高能量的纠缠观测 [abstract]。该观测展示了利用高能对撞机检验量子力学基础理解的潜力 [S1.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在探索最高可及能量尺度上的量子纠缠，此前纠缠在从微观到宏观的广泛系统中已被观测，但在最高能量尺度上仍基本未被探索 [abstract]。研究动机包括：在全新环境中探索量子纠缠的基础兴趣，以及展示利用 LHC 等高能对撞机作为检验量子力学基础理解工具的潜力 [S1.p1]。顶夸克因其独特性质（寿命远短于强子化和自旋退相干时间尺度）被提出作为研究量子纠缠和量子信息的新实验室 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。

evidence.quote: However, entanglement remains largely unexplored at the highest accessible energy scales.

Beyond the fundamental interest of exploring quantum entanglement in a novel setting, this observation demonstrates the potential of using high-energy colliders, such as the LHC, as tools for testing our fundamental understanding of quantum mechanics.
Recently, the heaviest fundamental particle known to exist, the top quark, was proposed as a new laboratory to study quantum entanglement and quantum information.

its immense mass gives it a lifetime ( ${\sim}10^{-25}$ s) notably shorter than the timescale needed for a quark’s quantum numbers to be shrouded by hadronization ( ${\sim}10^{-24}$ s) and spin decorrelation ( ${\sim}10^{-21}$ s) effects.

method.text: 论文利用顶夸克-反顶夸克对的自旋关联来探测量子纠缠效应，通过测量由母顶夸克和反顶夸克静止系中带电轻子间夹角推断出的单可观测量 D 来检测自旋纠缠 [abstract][S1.p2]。由于顶夸克寿命极短无法直接探测，其自旋信息传递给衰变产物，因此从带电轻子的角分布中提取自旋关联矩阵 C 的迹作为纠缠见证，tr[C]+1<0 是纠缠的充分条件 [S1.p7][S1.p8]。测量在接近 t\bar{t} 产生阈值的窄区间内进行，并在由稳定粒子定义的基准相空间中进行报告，以最小化蒙特卡洛事件产生器和部分子簇射模型在模拟顶夸克对产生时的局限性所带来的不确定性 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: Spin entanglement is detected from the measurement of a single observable D D , inferred from the angle between the charged leptons in their parent top- and antitop-quark rest frames.
In this Article, the spin correlation between the top quark and antitop quark is used to probe the effects of quantum entanglement

Since the information about the polarizations and spin correlations of the short-lived top quarks is transferred to the decay leptons, their values can be extracted from a measurement of angular observables associated with these leptons, allowing us to reconstruct the $t\bar{t}$ spin quantum state.
It is an observable that can signal the presence of entanglement, with $\textrm{tr}[\mathbf{C}]+1<0$ as a sufficient condition for entanglement.

It is reported in a fiducial phase space defined with stable particles to minimize the uncertainties that stem from limitations of the Monte Carlo event generators and the parton shower model in modeling top-quark pair production.

experiments.text: 测量使用 ATLAS 探测器在大型强子对撞机上记录的质子-质子对撞数据，质心能量为 13 TeV，积分亮度为 140 fb⁻¹ [abstract]。事件被分为三个分析区域，信号区域被构造为尽可能接近产生阈值，因为这是预期顶夸克纠缠最大化的区域 [S1.SS2.p3]。顶夸克从双轻子衰变产物中重建，主要使用 Ellipse 方法解析计算中微子动量，该方法在 85% 的事件中给出至少一个实数解；当该方法失败时使用 Neutrino Weighting 方法，仅用于约 5% 的事件 [Ax1.SS5.p3]。

evidence.quote: using a proton–proton collision dataset with a center-of-mass energy of s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV and an integrated luminosity of 140 fb -1 recorded with the ATLAS experiment.

The signal region is constructed to be dominated by events that are as close to the production threshold as the resolution of the reconstruction method will allow, as this is the region where the entanglement of the top quarks is expected to be maximized.
The main method used in this work is the Ellipse method, which is a geometric approach to analytically calculate the neutrino momenta. This method yields at least one real solution in 85% of events.
In this analysis, the Neutrino Weighting method is only used in a small fraction of events (about $5\%$).

findings.text: 在 340 < m_{t\bar{t}} < 380 GeV 区间，纠缠标记测量值为 D = −0.537 ± 0.002 (stat.) ± 0.019 (syst.) [abstract]。观测结果与无纠缠情景的偏差超过五个标准差，构成首次在夸克对中观测到纠缠，也是迄今最高能量的纠缠观测 [abstract]。在信号区域，观测和预期显著性相对于纠缠极限均远超五个标准差，且独立于用于将纠缠极限修正到测量基准相空间的蒙特卡洛模型 [S1.SS4.p4]。340 < m_{t\bar{t}} < 380 GeV 区域的观测结果确立了纠缠 t\bar{t} 态的形成 [S1.SS4.p4]。

evidence.quote: The entanglement marker is measured to be D = − 0.537 ± 0.002 ​ (stat.) ± 0.019 ​ (syst.) D=-0.537\pm0.002\penalty\ \text{(stat.)}\pm0.019\penalty\ \text{(syst.)} for 340 < m t ​ t ¯ < 380 340<m_{t\bar{t}}<380 GeV .

The observed result is more than five standard deviations from a scenario without entanglement and constitutes the first observation of entanglement in a pair of quarks and the highest-energy observation of entanglement so far.

In the signal region, the observed and expected significances with respect to the entanglement limit are well beyond five standard deviations, independently of the MC model used to correct the entanglement limit to account for the fiducial phase space of the measurement.
The observed result in the region with $340<m_{t\bar{t}}<380$ GeV establishes the formation of entangled $t\bar{t}$ states.

limitations.text: 论文指出，由于无法控制初始态的内部自由度，在 t\bar{t} 对中展示自旋纠缠具有挑战性；目前只能在像本文这样的受限相空间中通过专门分析来探测纠缠 [S1.p10]。此外，测量在由稳定粒子定义的基准相空间中进行，以最小化蒙特卡洛事件产生器和部分子簇射模型在模拟顶夸克对产生时的局限性所带来的不确定性 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: Nevertheless, a demonstration of spin entanglement in $t\bar{t}$ pairs is challenging due to the inability to control the internal degrees of freedom in the initial state.
Currently, entanglement can only be detected with the help of a dedicated analysis in a restricted phase space like the one presented here.

It is reported in a fiducial phase space defined with stable particles to minimize the uncertainties that stem from limitations of the Monte Carlo event generators and the parton shower model in modeling top-quark pair production.
